desc:
Your plane crashes into a town buried in snow. Miles of snow stand between you and the last rescue helicopter. Can you dig your way to freedom, or will you be left behind?

⛏️ Shovel Snow!
📦 Pack Snow into Boxes!
🚚 Load Trucks to earn CASH!
💰 Upgrade Tools & Vehicles!
🚁 Reach the Helicopter to ESCAPE!

👍 LIKE & FAVOURITE FOR UPDATES!

👥 SOLO & FRIEND RUNS SAVE!
